overview.heading: Leading the Path of Technical Innovation
overview.text: Munshiganj Polytechnic Institute (MPI) is a top-tier government institution under the Bangladesh Technical Education Board. We provide excellence in 8 specialized departments, focusing on creating industry-ready professionals.

missionVision.mission: To empower students through high-quality technical education, vocational training, and skill development to meet the global industrial challenges.
missionVision.vision: To become a center of excellence in technical education, fostering innovation, creativity, and professional ethics among future engineers.
